# Democracy Docket

> Democracy Docket is the leading digital news platform covering voting rights, election litigation, and democracy reform across the United States.

Democracy Docket provides comprehensive coverage of court cases, legislation, and policy developments impacting voting rights and election administration. The site features reporting from legal experts including Marc Elias, along with breaking news alerts, opinion pieces, and data-driven analysis on voting access, voter suppression, redistricting, and election integrity issues.

## Key Topics

- Voting Rights
- Election Litigation
- SAVE America Act
- Democracy Reform
- Redistricting & Gerrymandering
- Voter Suppression
- Election Administration
- Trump Accountability
- DOJ Enforcement
- Ballot Measures
- Voter Registration
- Election Legislation
- Marc Elias
- GOP Election Policy
- Senate Voting Legislation

## Core Coverage

- [Democracy Docket](https://www.democracydocket.com): Leading digital news platform for voting rights and election court coverage
- [Court Cases](https://www.democracydocket.com/cases): Tracks lawsuits nationwide impacting voting rights and election litigation
- [News & Insights](https://www.democracydocket.com/analysis): Analysis and insights on voting rights from legal experts and activists
- [Breaking News Alerts](https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts): Breaking news alerts on voting rights, litigation and election law
